description: Utility functions for handling tool nonce verification, output validation, and retry logic in openclaw probe processes.

methods.name: hasExpectedToolNonce
methods.description: Checks if the text includes both nonceA and nonceB.

methods.name: hasExpectedSingleNonce
methods.description: Checks if the text includes the specified nonce.

methods.name: isLikelyToolNonceRefusal
methods.description: Determines if the text likely indicates a tool nonce refusal based on specific markers.

methods.name: hasMalformedToolOutput
methods.description: Detects malformed or error-like output from the tool based on content patterns.

methods.name: shouldRetryToolReadProbe
methods.description: Decides whether to retry a tool read probe based on output, provider, and attempt count.

methods.name: shouldRetryExecReadProbe
methods.description: Decides whether to retry an execution read probe based on output, provider, and attempt count.
